items.title: Meta's social media payout sets precedent for Snap, Google, Roblox — and could be a 'negative'
items.summary: Meta (META) reached a settlement in its social media trial, agreeing to pay up to $16.7 billion, according to Reuters. Bloomberg Intelligence head of technology research Mandeep Singh chats with Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma about the ripple effects of the settlement.

items.title: Meta reaches $16.68 billion settlement in social media case
items.summary: Meta agreed to settle a social media addiction case with a group of state attorneys general on Wednesday, ending the trial in its second week and sending Meta's stock higher.

items.title: Meta, US states agree $16.7 bn settlement in landmark teen safety case
items.summary: Meta agreed to pay a coalition of US states as much as $16.7 billion and to impose sweeping new limits on how teenagers use Facebook and Instagram, according to a court filing on Wednesday that ends a landmark trial in California.The settlement ends the trial in its second week.

items.title: Why Meta Platforms Stock Popped Today
items.summary: The social media maven has reached a settlement in a high-profile legal case.

items.title: Meta agrees to sweeping changes to restrict kids’ access to its apps as part of settlement with states
items.summary: One of the most notable changes is that Meta plans to implement a daily two-hour time limit for teens that can only be disabled with parental permission.

items.title: Meta Heads Toward $580 as a $17B Teen Safety Settlement Ends the Trial; Snap Falls 9%
items.summary: A landmark legal settlement sent Meta stock climbing while Snap cratered 9% on the same day over the same issue, exposing a sharp divide in how courts and investors are treating the teen safety crisis hitting social media.
